What's Changed

## New Features

- Added per-host IPv4 bind addresses and opt-in IPv6 listener settings.
- Added DNS names to manual allow and deny lists with persistent A/AAAA address caching.
- Added source-country details to ranked blocked-IP statistics.

## Optimizations

- Refresh DNS-backed IP lists every 12 hours while retaining last-known addresses during DNS outages.

## Bug Fixes

- Keep DNS names out of generated Caddy IP matchers and apply only their validated resolved addresses.
- Reject private and reserved DNS results for deny lists.
